summary: Brookfield Private Equity Fund LP, a Delaware fund registrant, filed an 8-K reporting entry into a senior secured revolving credit agreement dated October 9, 2026, with GLAS USA LLC as administrative and collateral agent and Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce as lead arranger and lender. The facility provides up to $200 million, expandable to $500 million with lender consent, priced at Term SOFR plus 3.15% (3.40% on PIK portions) or base rate plus 2.15%, with a 0.70% commitment fee and interest capitalizable as PIK. Maturity is October 8, 2027, subject to monthly LTV-based extensions.
